spec.description:
Delete an exported trades/ledgers report. `delete` can only be used for reports that have already been processed; use `cancel` for reports that are still queued or processing.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Data - Export data`

id.description: ID of the report to delete or cancel.

type.description: `delete` can only be used for reports that have already been processed. Use `cancel` for queued or processing reports.

response.title: RemoveExportResult
response.description: Outcome of the delete/cancel operation. Exactly one of `delete`/`cancel` is present, matching the requested `type`.

delete.description: Whether deletion succeeded. Present when `type: "delete"` was requested.

cancel.description: Whether cancellation succeeded. Present when `type: "cancel"` was requested.
